scope: Actual Mathlib algebraic closures and elliptic groups. Refutes applying formulas outside their normal-form hypotheses, not either qualified formula. Separate geometric p-torsion helper theorems do not assert a trace/Hasse equivalence. Signed standing pending.
statement: The ordinary binary formula on y^2+y=x^3 overF2 at(1,0,0), and the short formula on y^2=x^3+x^2+1 overF3 at(0,0,0), give false zeros: each curve is nonsingular and no corresponding actual geometric zero-sum triple exists.
